text:
carla: FYI I'm going to land the 'quota routing cascade reconciler' migration branch next Wed, want quick sync on telemetry fields and console UX before we run backfill. :eyes:
dmitri: quick q — what's the intended cascade order? route -> tenant -> global? any profile-level overrides?
carla: yes exactly: route, tenant, then global. profile overrides allowed via profile_hint on the route. plan is to add cascade_version and quota_source to analytics events so we can trace which rule matched.
ben: how big will the new fields be for storage/indexing? worried about the p50/p99 query cost for dashboard queries that scan route metrics.
alex: for console UX we should expose a 'preview' column in route settings that shows "applied quota (source)" before cutover, and a grace_period toggle so customers see changes for 7 days before enforcement.
dmitri: agree on preview. For analytics, we need: quota_applied (bool), quota_source (enum: route|tenant|global|profile), cascade_version (int), profile_hash (nullable string). that lets us diff evals.
carla: SQL patch I'm thinking to add (will dual-write during rollout):
```sql
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN quota_applied boolean DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN quota_source text;
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN cascade_version integer DEFAULT 0;
CREATE INDEX idx_console_events_quota ON console_events (quota_source, cascade_version);
```
ben: idx across text might be heavy, maybe use enum/int for quota_source for compact index. also consider a partial index for events where quota_applied = true.
dmitri: +1 partial index. and use smallint for source enum to save bytes.
carla: good — I'll change quota_source -> smallint and add partial index. runtime will map: 0=route,1=tenant,2=global,3=profile.
alex: about backfill: do we plan dual-write + async backfill or shadow write then cutover? I prefer dual-write + canary so console dashboards don't show gaps.
carla: dual-write to new fields for 2 weeks, then backfill historical 90 days in batches. canary to 10% of routes first. we'll also expose rollout state in Console under Settings -> Quotas rollout.
ben: how will this affect materialized aggregates used by the dashboard p99? those materialized views currently group by route_id and event_kind. adding cascade_version breaks cardinality. we should keep aggregates by cascade_version only when needed. maybe new mv for quota-aware aggregates.
dmitri: yes, create a separate MV: route_quota_agg(route_id, cascade_version, sum_tokens, p99_latency). keep default dashboard queries pointing at old MV until we flip flag.
carla: good call. we'll also add a lightweight sampling column 'quota_sample_v' on summon events so old views stay small.
alex: UX question — when we show "applied quota" in the route settings, what do we show if cascade_version > 0 but profile_hash absent? fallback note?
dmitri: show source + version + a short explanation: "Applied from tenant default (v3)." and link to audit trail. audit trail will query console_events for cascade_version + route_id.
carla: deploy-bot: migration scheduled: quota-cascade-migration starts 2026-03-25T05:00Z.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled by carla. ETA 30m, will run dual-write feature flag 'quota_cascade_dualwrite'.
ben: one more ops note — add a circuit-breaker: if MV build time > 4h or backfill error rate > 5% we auto-pause and notify #eng-platform oncall.
carla: noted, adding health gates to runbook. I'll post the runbook link after I open the PR. Thanks all :rocket:
